module_summary: Clock divider producing 50, 10 and 1 MHz clocks from 100 MHz: a toggle flop for /2 and two terminal-count counters toggling /10 and /100 outputs.

anchors.name: CLK_50
anchors.why: Divide-by-2 clock output toggled every input clock

anchors.name: CLK_10
anchors.why: Divide-by-10 clock toggled when cnt_10 reaches 4

anchors.name: CLK_1
anchors.why: Divide-by-100 clock toggled when cnt_100 reaches 49

groups.name: div2
groups.description: Toggle flop dividing input clock by 2

groups.name: div10
groups.description: Mod-5 counter toggling CLK_10 for divide-by-10

groups.name: div100
groups.description: Mod-50 counter toggling CLK_1 for divide-by-100
